dispositions.local_proposition: Requester was authorized when a direct admission was parked.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Requester remains authorized when admission executes.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Earlier valid capability, effective withdrawal before execution, later current-authority decision must all be evidenced; parked state alone does not establish withdrawal.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates current authority using evidence whose observation or production time predates the material revocation or withdrawal.
falsification: The system returns PASS for current authority solely from evidence known to predate the material revocation or withdrawal.
The system cannot establish evidence freshness but converts that uncertainty into PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Recheck live entry and capability at execution; deny or defer stale authority.
dispositions.comparison: limited: execution-time recheck is explicit in task; ceremony exposes interval.

dispositions.local_proposition: Earlier membership-derived authority was valid.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Former member may exercise same authority after effective withdrawal.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires valid evidence at t1, effective withdrawal t2 and reliance t3; membership departure must actually remove relevant authority, not unrelated grant.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates current authority using evidence whose observation or production time predates the material revocation or withdrawal.
falsification: The system returns PASS for current authority solely from evidence known to predate the material revocation or withdrawal.
The system cannot establish evidence freshness but converts that uncertainty into PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Deny withdrawn authority or return indeterminate without current evidence; preserve legitimate historical claims.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: connects admission-derived evidence and termination to subsequent reliance.

dispositions.sections: Decision Conformance; List Retention; Revoke Conformance
dispositions.local_proposition: Earlier allow was recorded and cached.
dispositions.relying_proposition: That allow still authorizes delivery after effective revoke.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires valid allow at t1, effective revoke t2, delivery t3 relying on earlier state; no observed deployment.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates current authority using evidence whose observation or production time predates the material revocation or withdrawal.
falsification: The system returns PASS for current authority solely from evidence known to predate the material revocation or withdrawal.
The system cannot establish evidence freshness but converts that uncertainty into PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Default-deny; check authoritative state where required.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value for core mechanism already identified in #135.

dispositions.local_proposition: A delegated signing key can act within the underlying entry and role ceiling.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Delegate can admit at a role beyond grant or assign authority it does not hold.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual bounded delegation, out-of-scope requested admission and reliance on delegation. Do not assume all administrators delegates.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates an action whose requested scope exceeds, is not included in, or cannot be derived from the authoritative delegation scope.
falsification: The system returns PASS for an action whose scope is outside the scope established by the authoritative delegation chain.
The system treats an omitted, unresolved, or unverified delegation scope as unrestricted authority.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check exact capability, role ceiling and delegation lineage; refuse out-of-scope role.
dispositions.comparison: limited: explicit task controls already cover mechanism.

dispositions.local_proposition: Authorized administrator can remove under community capability.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Delegate with bounded resource authority can remove member outside its scope.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual delegation, requested removal outside scope and reliance on delegation; mere admin title not evidence of chain.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates an action whose requested scope exceeds, is not included in, or cannot be derived from the authoritative delegation scope.
falsification: The system returns PASS for an action whose scope is outside the scope established by the authoritative delegation chain.
The system treats an omitted, unresolved, or unverified delegation scope as unrestricted authority.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check live removal capability and scope; reject inferred unrestricted authority.
dispositions.comparison: limited: local removal authorization already required; cross-ceremony trace explains origin.

dispositions.local_proposition: Enrolled bridge may attest operator choice for authorized subject/context.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Bridge is authorized to make a different decision or widen consent from receive to converse.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires competent bounded delegation or attestation authority, out-of-scope action and reliance on that authority; grant itself not necessarily delegation.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates an action whose requested scope exceeds, is not included in, or cannot be derived from the authoritative delegation scope.
falsification: The system returns PASS for an action whose scope is outside the scope established by the authoritative delegation chain.
The system treats an omitted, unresolved, or unverified delegation scope as unrestricted authority.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Verify actual operator choice and issuer authority for exact subject/context/scope; reject scope widening.
dispositions.comparison: limited: #135 already covers scope and provenance; ceremony tracks release boundary.

dispositions.local_proposition: Delegated key may act for live access-control entry.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Key remains entitled to admit after underlying entry withdrawn.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual upstream dependency, subsequent loss/unverifiability and reliance on dependent key; no preservation rule established.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates a delegation after the state of its required authority source has materially changed or can no longer be established.
falsification: The system returns PASS from the dependent delegation after its required authority source has been established as withdrawn or revoked and no preservation rule applies.
The system cannot establish the current state of the required authority source but treats the dependent delegation as current authority.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Re-evaluate underlying entry and chain before admission; deny/defer.
dispositions.comparison: limited: explicit task live-entry check already captures this.

dispositions.local_proposition: Member may previously have derived delegable authority from membership.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Dependent delegate can still act after the upstream membership-derived authority is withdrawn.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires an actual dependent delegation, effective source loss and later reliance; independent grants or explicit preservation rules are countercases.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates a delegation after the state of its required authority source has materially changed or can no longer be established.
falsification: The system returns PASS from the dependent delegation after its required authority source has been established as withdrawn or revoked and no preservation rule applies.
The system cannot establish the current state of the required authority source but treats the dependent delegation as current authority.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Trace dependencies and current authority, revoke dependent scope only where required.
dispositions.potential_impact: Former member, delegate, service; continued unauthorized access or over-revocation.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: cross-ceremony lineage distinguishes source loss from artifact revocation.

dispositions.local_proposition: Enrolled bridge attests operator choice under contextual authorization.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Bridge continues to decide after its underlying enrollment/authorization is withdrawn.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual dependent authority chain and later source loss, not merely deletion of an unrelated conversation grant; current reliance must be shown.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates a delegation after the state of its required authority source has materially changed or can no longer be established.
falsification: The system returns PASS from the dependent delegation after its required authority source has been established as withdrawn or revoked and no preservation rule applies.
The system cannot establish the current state of the required authority source but treats the dependent delegation as current authority.

dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Verify live enrollment and authorized issuer/context; do not presume operator grant persists or fails solely from bridge change.
dispositions.comparison: limited: task issuer authorization already explicit; composition traces source dependency.

dispositions.local_proposition: Proof authenticates applicant or requester; admission separately authorized.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Signature alone authorizes principal's exact material commitment.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: No principal-derived material commitment semantics established by selected admission path; unauthorized admission is not automatically this case.

falsification: The system returns PASS solely because the signature or actor identity verifies.
The system cannot establish the mandate but converts the missing evidence into PASS.

dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check applicable admission capability/criterion; require exact mandate if a distinct commitment is in scope.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value: signature vs authority distinction present but commitment precondition absent.

dispositions.local_proposition: Proof authenticates removing administrator.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Signature proves principal authorized a material commitment.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Removal is consequential but no separate material commitment on behalf of principal is established.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system accepts the commitment because the message signature verifies.
falsification: The system returns PASS solely because the signature or actor identity verifies.
The system cannot establish the mandate but converts the missing evidence into PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Require live admin capability and policy; exact commitment mandate only where separately established.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value: do not collapse administrative authorization into commitment.

dispositions.local_proposition: Direct or bridge proof establishes provenance, not arbitrary mandate.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Agent reply creates material commitment authorized by operator signature/bridge attestation.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Converse permits replies, not necessarily a principal-binding material commitment; actual commitment and missing exact mandate are not established.

dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Enforce grant scope; separately verify commitment authority if a binding action is attempted.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/counterparty; unauthorized commitment if additional facts exist.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value within delivery profile; distinct commitment extension would need evidence.

dispositions.local_proposition: Expired entry cannot authorize direct admission.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Expired principal mandate authorizes a new material commitment.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Explicit entry expiry relevant, but no commitment or principal mandate established by this profile.

dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check live entry; separately evaluate mandate at commitment where applicable.

dispositions.local_proposition: Removal requires current competent capability.

dispositions.local_proposition: Removal requests have disposition and authority boundaries.

dispositions.local_proposition: A referred direct-admission action may obtain additional approval.

dispositions.sections: Submit Retention/Deciding; Admit audit; VTI-MEM-012; VTI-CMP-091
dispositions.local_proposition: Admission records evidence and governing criterion or approval.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Historical organizational commitment can be defended using current criteria/authority.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires prior admission or refusal constituting a material commitment under governing policy, later review and missing/overwritten inputs. Source requires records; does not show loss.
dispositions.trigger: The system presents current authority state or an agent explanation as though it proves the historical decision basis.
falsification: Current state is substituted for historical state without qualification.
Missing historical evidence is silently represented as verified historical authority.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Reconstruct original criterion, authority, evidence and decision or mark unavailable; do not substitute current state.
dispositions.comparison: added-value conditional: collect historical decision basis across task boundaries; commitment classification must be established.

dispositions.local_proposition: Removal audit can survive record purge.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Past material organizational commitment to removal is proven by present state.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires material commitment classification, later dispute and missing original authority/policy/action evidence; permitted erasure not automatically a failure.
dispositions.trigger: The system presents current authority state or an agent explanation as though it proves the historical decision basis.
falsification: Current state is substituted for historical state without qualification.
Missing historical evidence is silently represented as verified historical authority.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.

dispositions.local_proposition: Decision provenance may support historical grant reconstruction.

dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Preserve applicable grant provenance; separately assess exact commitment evidence if in scope.

dispositions.sections: Manifest branding; Submit requested attributes; VTI-CMP-030–032
dispositions.local_proposition: Branding, self-assertions, and valid credentials can supply scoped evidence.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Aggregated endorsements or self-assertions grant admission authority outside competent policy.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual non-authority signals, missing/narrow authority and use of those signals as authorization. Legitimate evidence of eligibility not inherently laundering.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system treats the combined or transformed non-authoritative signals as sufficient authority for the consequential action.
falsification: The system returns PASS because multiple non-authoritative actors repeat or agree with an instruction.
Reputation, capability, discovery, endorsement, projection, or aggregation causes the evaluated authority to exceed the authority established by competent provenance.
Authority for one scope is treated as authority for an unrelated requested scope without a valid delegation or governing rule.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Trace competent admission decision and scope; do not upgrade self-asserted attributes or branding into authority.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: shows transformations across evidence and decision seam, though source already prohibits several substitutions.

falsification: The system returns PASS because multiple non-authoritative actors repeat or agree with an instruction.

limitations: Conditional hypotheses only; no observed failure or independent acceptance.
Commitment-specific cases require actual material commitment and applicable mandate or approval semantics; consequential membership or delivery alone is insufficient.
No additional deployment evidence introduced. VTI is separately pinned comparative evidence.
Per-precondition adversarial review and final matrix validation remain pending.
